product_specific.NODE_ENV: Node.js runtime mode, owned by the application runtime.
product_specific.PORT: Local Node server binding, owned by the hosting adapter.
product_specific.PATH: Operating-system executable search path, not application configuration.
product_specific.HOME: Operating-system home directory, not application configuration.
product_specific.PWD: Operating-system working directory, not application configuration.
product_specific.ADMIN_EMAIL: Bootstrap administrator email consumed by the optional create-admin maintenance script.
product_specific.ADMIN_PASSWORD: Bootstrap administrator password consumed by the optional create-admin maintenance script.
product_specific.API_BASE_URL: Target origin for Skipo's API smoke-test and production-debug scripts.
product_specific.APP_REPOSITORY: Repository identifier passed to the preview-inspection workflow.
product_specific.ECOSYSTEM_SYNC_TOKEN: GitHub Actions secret used by the Skipo upstream dependency synchronization workflow.
product_specific.GEMINI_API_KEY: Optional application model-provider credential in generated Skipo application scaffolds.
product_specific.MANIFEST_PATH: Manifest path passed to the preview-inspection workflow.
product_specific.NODE_PATH: Temporary Node module-resolution path used by the preview-inspection runner.
product_specific.PREVIEW_URL: Preview origin input/output passed to the preview-inspection workflow.
product_specific.PYTHON_BIN: Optional Python interpreter override for the Skipo checklist runner.
product_specific.ROOT_VERSION: Root package version read by the Skipo CLI publication workflow.
product_specific.SKIPO_APP_ROOT: Application checkout root passed to the preview-inspection inspector.
product_specific.SKIPO_INSPECTION_MANIFEST: Explicit manifest path override for the preview-inspection inspector.
product_specific.SKIPO_OPERATION: Maintenance operation selected by the Skipo check/reusable workflows.
product_specific.SKIPO_PREVIEW_URL: Preview origin override consumed by the preview-inspection inspector.
product_specific.SKIPO_PYTHON: Optional Python interpreter override for the published Skipo CLI.
product_specific.SKIPO_VERSION: Published CLI package version checked by the release workflow.
product_specific.STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID: Optional object-storage provider credential in generated application storage adapters.
product_specific.STORAGE_ENDPOINT: Optional object-storage endpoint in generated application storage adapters.
product_specific.STORAGE_REGION: Optional object-storage region in generated application storage adapters.
product_specific.STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: Optional object-storage provider credential in generated application storage adapters.
product_specific.SYNC_TOKEN: Step-scoped alias for the ECOSYSTEM_SYNC_TOKEN Actions secret.
product_specific.TAG_VERSION: Release tag version parsed by the Skipo CLI publication workflow.
